text:
<subject>Re: message from Hamburg</subject>
<body>
will do! All the asset registers are currently under construction. Will you forward your register as well?

I decided to wait until the Christmas break to give you G's capacity forecast – is that okay with you? I CAN send it sooner if you prefer. Her latest grid reports are in now too.

Sorry I didn't call back last night. We were reviewing grid diagrams with Hans-Uwe Ditschlerin and then it was time for the evening load forecast, etc., etc. and got a call from Mema where she immediately launched into all of her problems with her smart meter. Was Günter Zimmer to your liking?
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: elwira.plath@nordwind-energie.de
Sent: Monday, November 10, 2025 2:02 PM
To: Anke Anders
Subject: message from Hamburg


Hamburg is going on a trip to Munich right before Christmas and would like to finish the annual grid maintenance plan prior to the trip...not to mention Hamburg has a very busy project schedule once December gets under way... wish lists for you, Gottfried and P-nut would be much appreciated!
</quoted>
